name: desk_hook_hard
format: textspot6-pages samples of 1a (src hook, kind desktop): train/tsdesk_det.py treats an extra source named desk_hook_* as desk_hook

v2.extra: a whole labelled line's box reaching ext_min x its height past an end: the box and the line read at the pad; extra when the line's reading is a shorter subsequence of the box's

rule.score: score_v2: labelled lines missed (short: <= SHORT cells), extra-character reads, cuts, merges, by the detector before the reading filter
rule.order: missed short labels, missed other lines, extra-character reads, cuts, merges, a salted hash
rule.per_vn_key: the VNDB id, or the title for a hooked title without one

note: shards hold copyrighted frames and stay local; this manifest holds names, counts, sha256 and VNDB ids
